rules.title: Dominion
rules.description: Deckbuilding: buy cards to grow a better deck. You against a Big Money bot. Change "kingdom" in the game file to play with other cards.

cellar: discarded = choose_up_to(hand, count(hand), 'Cellar: discard any number of cards, then draw that many')
chapel: move(choose_up_to(hand, 4, 'Chapel: trash up to 4 cards'), trash)
workshop: move(choose(matching(tops(supply), 'within_limit'), 'Workshop: gain a card costing up to 4'), discard)
remodel: trashed = choose(hand, 'Remodel: trash a card from your hand')
move(choose(matching(tops(supply), 'within_limit'), 'Remodel: gain a card costing up to %d' % gain_limit), discard)
mine: trashed = choose_up_to(matching(hand, 'is_treasure'), 1, 'Mine: trash a treasure from your hand')

then: move(choose(matching(tops(supply), 'treasure_within_limit'), 'Mine: gain a treasure costing up to %d into your hand' % gain_limit), hand)

throne_room: doubled = choose_up_to(matching(hand, 'is_action'), 1, 'Throne Room: play an action from your hand twice')

then: immune = choose(['Reveal Moat', 'Keep it hidden'], 'Moat: reveal it to block the attack?') == 'Reveal Moat'

status.victory points: '%s %d, %s %d' % [name_of(1), sum([deck_1, hand_1, play_1, discard_1], 'vp'), name_of(2), sum([deck_2, hand_2, play_2, discard_2], 'vp')]

bot.prefer: 20 * (sum(my_cards, 'coins') - count(matching(my_cards, 'is_copper'))) / count(my_cards) + 4 * min(count(matching(my_cards, 'is_terminal')), floor(count(my_cards) / 10)) + 3 * min(sum(my_cards, 'cards'), count(matching(my_cards, 'is_action'))) / count(my_cards) * 10 + sum(my_cards, 'vp') + 0.01 * coins
